expected.title: Exact residue obstruction for meromorphic Abelian differentials on the Riemann sphere with one zero and only simple poles
expected.author: Quentin Gendron; Guillaume Tahar
expected.difficulty_reason: The residue theorem only gives the sum-zero constraint and does not characterize the exceptional integral resonances for a single zero. The authors construct and recognize weighted connection trees by gluing flat polar domains, then prove commensurability of every excluded configuration and the sharp integer total bound through leaf-removal induction. The reverse saddle-connection-length argument supplies the full obstruction rather than merely a sufficient gluing recipe.
